# domosenso.org readable by AI agents — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** domosenso.org serves `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt` and an `index.md` beside every content page, generated by `next build` from the published content and tested against it; get-started covers the "no Home Assistant yet" route; README, get-started and `llms.txt` give one set of clone commands.

**Architecture:** Pure generator functions in `website/src/lib/` (`install.ts`, `markdown.ts`, `llms.ts`) take the same objects the pages render. `force-static` route handlers (the pattern of `src/app/journal/feed.xml/route.ts`) call them; the static export writes the files into `out/`. The README's "Prerequisites" reach the site through `tools/export_website.py` at `frameworkCommit`, like every published document.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 static export (`output: 'export'`, `trailingSlash: true`), TypeScript, Jest, Playwright; Python exporter run with `uv`; Cloudflare Pages `_headers`.

**Spec:** `.ai/specs/SPEC-020-2026-10-29-agent-readable-website.md` (approved 2026-10-29). Read it with this plan.

## Global Constraints

- Canonical origin `https://domosenso.org` (`origin` in `website/src/lib/seo.ts`).
- Markdown URL of a page = its HTML path + `index.md` (e.g. `/how-to/<slug>/index.md`); served as `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8` with `Link: <html url>; rel="canonical"`.
- Production builds (`CF_PAGES_BRANCH` unset or `main`) never contain a draft how-to in any file; use `visibleHowTos(howTos)` everywhere.
- `howtos.json` and `@/lib/howto` are imported only from server modules (route handlers, server pages), never from `'use client'` code.
- Clone commands are exactly README's "Start in 10 minutes" block: `gh repo clone zerostorypoints/domosenso` / `cd domosenso` / `uv sync` / `claude`. No `git checkout <commit>` anywhere.
- `.md` URLs stay out of `sitemap.xml`; `robots.txt` unchanged.
- Component markdown leaves out `host.installs`; missing evidence stays missing (`evidenceLabel`).
- No household data in any file; English text; Node 22 (`website/.node-version`); Python through `uv run`.
- Commit messages say what changed, `git log` style, ending with the `Co-Authored-By` line.

## Review Focus

1. A how-to prompt containing backticks or a fenced block must stay one intact fence in the `.md` → `fence()` picks a fence longer than any backtick run (Task 3).
2. Bodies with root-relative links and images (`/wiring/…`, `/hardware/…`, `/docs/…`) must resolve for an agent that fetched the `.md` alone → `absolutize()` (Task 3).
3. A `coming-soon` branch without `issue` must read "Coming soon", never "undefined" (Task 3).
4. `testedHomes` `null` and `0` must read differently ("Field evidence not recorded" vs "Not field-tested") (Task 3).
5. A title or description containing `[` or `]` must not break an `llms.txt` link line → `linkText()` escapes them (Task 5).

- Produces: `type Device=typeof devices[number]`, `type Doc=typeof docs[number]`; `fence(text:string,lang?:string):string`; `absolutize(md:string):string` (rewrites `](/` to `](https://domosenso.org/`); `markdownPage(path:string,title:string,sections:string[]):string` → `Canonical: <origin+path>\n\n# <title>\n\n<sections joined by blank lines>\n`; `howToMarkdown(h:HowTo):string`; `componentMarkdown(c:Component):string`; `deviceMarkdown(d:Device):string`; `docMarkdown(d:Doc):string`; `articleMarkdown(a:Article):string`; `getStartedMarkdown():string`. ### Task 5: `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`

**Files:**
- Create: `website/src/lib/llms.ts`, `website/src/app/llms.txt/route.ts`, `website/src/app/llms-full.txt/route.ts`
- Test: `website/src/lib/llms.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Tasks 1–3; `agent.json` (Task 2) as `{prerequisites:string}`.
- Produces: `type AgentIndexInput={howTos:HowTo[];components:Component[];devices:Device[];docs:Doc[];articles:Article[];prerequisites:string}`; `linkText(s:string):string` (escapes `[` and `]` with a backslash); `llmsTxt(i:AgentIndexInput):string`; `llmsFullTxt(i:AgentIndexInput):string`. Routes pass `{howTos:visibleHowTos(howTos),components:catalog,devices,docs,articles,prerequisites:agent.prerequisites}` and return `text/plain; charset=utf-8`.
- `llms.txt` layout, in this order (llmstxt.org): `# DomoSenso`; `> DomoSenso is an Apache-2.0 catalog of tested Home Assistant components and the agent skills that install them. Your coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) adds components to your own home repository; you approve every change to Home Assistant.`; `## Start here` (two routes: "You run Home Assistant Container" → `fence(installCommands,'bash')`, then `/onboard-home` and `starterPrompt`; "No Home Assistant yet" → `noHomeAssistant`; link to `/get-started/index.md`); `## Limits` (the `prerequisites` text, absolutized); `## How-to guides` (per how-to a list item linking `linkText(title)` to `<origin>/how-to/<slug>/index.md`, then `: <description>`, followed by one indented line per branch `  - <situation> → yes | coming soon (<issue>) | no`); `## Components`, `## Hardware`, `## Docs` (one link line each to its `index.md`, with summary/title); `## For coding agents` (`agentRules` as a list, link to `https://github.com/zerostorypoints/domosenso/blob/main/AGENTS.md`); `## Optional` (journal articles' `index.md`, `/releases/`, `/contribute/`).
- `llms-full.txt`: `llmsTxt` header block through `## Limits`, then for each how-to, then get-started, then each component: `---` line and the page's full markdown from Task 3.

## After merge (needs the maintainer's go-ahead for push, PR and any external submit)

- Open the PR into `main`; after the Pages deploy run README's acceptance checks, including the two new ones.
- The maintainer checks Cloudflare AI Crawl Control.
- Write `docs/research/<date>-agent-indexing.md`: Bing Webmaster (sitemap processed, `llms.txt` and a how-to fetched), Search Console sitemap state, a Brave search for `site:domosenso.org how-to`; repeat a week later and append.
